run_act_quant: run block-wise FP8 activation quantization on a contiguous PyTorch tensor with configurable block size
run_get_valid_kv_indices: run extraction of valid (non -1) indices from a page table into a compacted kv_indices buffer
build_act_quant_kernel: build a Triton kernel that quantizes tensor blocks to FP8 with per-group scaling factors
build_get_valid_kv_indices_kernel: build a Triton kernel that compacts valid page table indices using prefix sum per batch
test_act_quant: test the act_quant function with a contiguous tensor whose last dimension is divisible by block_size
